package.description: Free FTP, SFTP and cloud storage client

en-US.description: Free FTP, SFTP and cloud storage client
en-US.longDescription: FTP Rush is a free file transfer client for FTP, FTPS, SFTP and cloud storage, supporting Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Amazon S3 with a tabbed Explorer-like interface, drag and drop transfers, and C# scripting.
en-US.name: FTP Rush

zh-CN.description: 免费的 FTP、SFTP 和云存储客户端
zh-CN.longDescription: FTP Rush 是一款免费的文件传输客户端，支持 FTP、FTPS、SFTP 和云存储（Google Drive、Dropbox、OneDrive 和 Amazon S3），具有标签式资源管理器界面、拖放传输和 C# 脚本功能。
